title: Position: AI Evaluation Should Learn from How We Test Humans

bias_targets.methodology: Proposed adaptation of the Implicit Association Test (IAT) measuring associations between concepts (e.g., young/old faces) and attributes (e.g., good/bad words)
Proposed adaptation of Conjoint Analysis (Decision-Making Model) to assess preferences for candidates with varying attributes like gender and race/ethnicity
Proposed adaptation of Conjoint Analysis presenting candidate profiles with different genders in hiring scenarios
Proposed adaptation of Conjoint Analysis presenting candidate profiles with different races/ethnicities in hiring scenarios
Proposed adaptation of Likert Scales (Attitude Model) to measure AI attitudes or opinions through graded responses
